maria-okonkwo.rationale: Broad CISSP-domain knowledge with accreditation and a four-year profile fits professional information-security judgment. The record does not show endorsement or hands-on assessment, so equivalent expert assurance cannot be inferred from domain overlap.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded four-year profile and broad CISSP-domain coverage support professional security judgment. An unspecified proctored knowledge exam does not establish the practical or senior evidence needed for expert placement.
